notes.title: Endocrisis is less difficult now
notes.notes:
If you lose, now you can continue without re-start the whole level or boss. 
Some bugs are fixed

notes.title: Endocrisis is less difficult now
notes.notes:
Endocrisis was too hard on his initial phase. 
To make it more enjoyable now you have 60 continues 

The 60 Continues are set when you Start a New Game if you lost all of them you can still playing, but you can't continue on the same level. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39463890/46d790462d2dbc33ef94e546ed1ffbb70101dd9f.png[/img]

notes.title: How was Developing Endocrisis
notes.notes:
Endocrisis is my first project, I left my job for it and spent a lot of time with it and finally now it's finished. If you want to ask something about its development, do not hesitate, I will also be attentive to suggestions for future planning a DLC or Sequel.

By the way, Endocrisis started as an Android game and ended up on Steam ... that's how long the road was.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39463890/c7dc1556bfa52b2a6151f7723e590f670ce4ba9d.png[/img]

notes.title: Improvements And Demo Available
notes.notes:
[h3]Now Endocrisis have a map with saving progress. You can play the game and complete stages or defeat bosses in any order.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39463890/8392b7a3909c8b6a0ad017b897f7c63aed47af92.png[/img]


[h3]When you stop shooting, the whole spaceship is covered with armor that blocks any impact and decreases your energy bar.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39463890/4f8d6c415e53411c726d4d2de0287fea87a4b8f2.png[/img]


[h3]It is clearer to know the number of enemies to destroy on each stage to power up your ship. Each stage has a different powerup[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39463890/06d9dfeead3571f0952a80acdceb010e27c35c67.png[/img]


[h3]Another mayor updates[/h3]
Absorb graphic is more clear
Bosses and enemies now have less health.
Power shot now deals more damage 
Code improvement
Bug fixes.
